findings.message: Bug A — _resolve_workspace walks to child .dadaia/ in sub-repos before workspace root, raising 'Workspace not initialized' for any CLI invocation from inside repos/redacted-slug, repos/redacted-slug, repos/dadaia-workspace, or repos/workflow-tools. Root cause: duplicate of the function in cli/commands/server.py:26-30 and cli/commands/panel.py:24-29 both check only for .dadaia/ existence, not .dadaia/states/spec_contexts.json.

Bug B — JsonServerRegistryStore._load and _from_dict raise on JSONDecodeError / KeyError / TypeError, blanking the entire registry from a single malformed entry. /api/servers returns {'groups': []} despite valid entries on disk.

Bug C — OsProcessProbe.is_pid_alive treats PermissionError the same as ProcessLookupError, marking root-owned PIDs (e.g. docker-proxy) as stale. ServerRegistryService._sweep() then deletes those entries on next register() call from any project.

Gap D — Registry is push-only. Agents spawning python -m http.server without calling dadaia server register produce orphans invisible to the panel. No reconciliation surface exists. Fix: new dadaia server scan CLI subcommand (read-only) + panel Unregistered listeners section.

decisions_required: Approve v0.1.1 SPEC and proceed to P1 (resolver fix) — already locked via operator response 'Go ahead' on the approved plan.
After PR #9 merges to main, rebase hotfix/dev-server-registry-v0.1.1 onto updated main.
